structure: PROGRAMME-NOTES.md for the DR1 parity union programme: a Markdown build-run notes file (247 lines, undated as a whole, rulings inside attributed to Rhys on 2026-08-28, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-07), copied from commit 6688fd8e on origin/feat/parity-report-triage-view. It records the standing rulings and blocks on a 161-increment backlog comparing the live-animals frontend with Design Release 1 of the GB-notification-service prototype. Sections in order: title and preamble (lines 1-5); What the backlog is (7-14); Standing rulings - do not re-raise these (16-29), with one table, columns Increment | Ruling, 5 rows (inc-062 dropped, inc-094, inc-030, inc-031, inc-013 rejected); The dashboard and the address book are blocked as groups (31-55: 17 dashboard and 2 address-book-scoping increments); The address space is blocked while the team works in it (57-90: 12 address increments blocked, 5 left todo, EUDPA-399 parked); Reference-data lists come from MDM, not from this backlog (92-139: inc-081, inc-071, inc-127 blocked; inc-106, inc-107, inc-110 stay todo); inc-161 carries its own design decision (141-161: rule (b) on return controls, seven templates, ordering with inc-006, 29 screens); Seven increments disagree about banding (163-176, inc-091 called out); Provenance, and why ids look odd (178-190); Evidence lives in the per-run reports (192-207); Pins (209-217: frontend and prototype commits); Target (219-226); Disputed increments are deferred to their own pass (228-247: inc-103, inc-126, inc-145 deferred). Small enough for one agent to read every word, so the whole file in scope is one part; nothing is left out.
